human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Close the MVP with an operator guide: receive exported packages, validate/import/project one or many, start read server, open console, inspect Run Report, Overview, Problems, and interpret mapping coverage/unknowns. Include rollback/rebuild semantics and deferred realtime work. Dependency: 8026.add-batch-import-project.
human_pressure.why_now: The data pipeline must be operable and auditable end to end, not just implemented as disconnected functions.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.

machine_core.goal: Document the full Ailuros dogfood operating procedure and product acceptance checklist.
invariants: Depends on: 8026.add-batch-import-project. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: End-to-end acceptance is evidence package -> import -> projection -> report/analytics -> console.
failure_semantics: Guide distinguishes invalid package, import conflict, projection failure, and no observed signal.

steps.title: Document package intake
details: Evidence package is the only EverRun handoff.

steps.title: Document projection/rebuild
details: How to rebuild without touching raw evidence.

steps.title: Document product usage
details: Run Report -> Overview -> Problems -> evidence drill-down.

steps.title: Document deferred phases
details: Realtime ingestion, runtime decision API, LLM explanation, multi-tenant SaaS, ClickHouse/OTel scale-out are not part of this MVP.

acceptance: Guide explains unknown/no-signal is not equivalent to clean.
Guide explicitly keeps realtime and AI explanation deferred.
validate: python -m pytest tests/test_evidence_contract_v1.py tests/test_runtime_evidence_contract_v1.py tests/test_evidence_package_ingest.py tests/test_projection_storage.py tests/test_execution_projection_model.py tests/test_projection_lifecycle.py tests/test_projection_runtime_facts.py tests/test_projection_decisions.py tests/test_governance_signals.py tests/test_projection_rebuild.py tests/test_execution_report.py tests/test_fleet_analytics.py tests/test_problem_aggregation.py tests/test_batch_evidence_import.py -q

reject_if: Guide instructs Ailuros to read native history.
Guide claims realtime or AI diagnosis is implemented.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Runs the focused backend dogfood suite plus static/type checks; console-specific tests are covered in their own packs.
